records.title: Farmers Enrolled under PM-KMY

records.title: ALTERNATIVE TO CORONATION BRIDGE
details:
Part (a); (a) The Detailed Project Report (DPR) for construction of additional bridge on NH-17 over river Teesta in the state of West Bengal is under
finalisation for sanction of the project.

records.title: INDIAN NAVIC SYSTEM.
details: d: ISRO is also formulating a proposal to develop and deploy Bharatiya Antariksh Station (BAS) in Low earth orbit. Currently, the teams are working on the preparation of a detailed project report for the same.
